svg.text: WF-002 — MESI read sharing with owner AXI writeback
Owner's existing HPDcache AXI writeback path
PREPARE completion after matching B response
COMMIT, directory update, and permission grant

Logical aliases, not finalized RTL ports. Hart 0 stays M and locked while its HPDcache flush engine writes X as two 64-bit W beats through the existing AXI path. PREPARE completes only after the matching successful B response. COMMIT(S) changes the owner state; directory update and permission grant follow the COMMIT ACK. The grant permits hart 1's normal HPDcache refill from LLC; it is not CPU load completion. All cycle positions are illustrative and specify no latency or throughput.
